card.name: Present-time words like currently and now
card.fires_on: Words that mark the present moment, mainly "currently" and "now" (sometimes "is" or "current"), placed before an adjective or verb such as "available", "called" or "pending".

modes.label: currently available
modes.description: "Currently" sits between a noun and "available" or a similar state, often about data or resources.
modes.example: No prospective data are<< currently>> available in patients with risk factors for renal

modes.label: now as present-day status
modes.description: "Now" gives the present name or status of a place or thing, contrasting with the past.

card.writes: It favors words about ongoing or pending states ("正在", "pending", "imminent") and suppresses counts, past-duration words and "successfully".
card.plain: It fires on words like "currently" and "now" that say something is true at the present time.
